def _rewrite_list_item(tok: Dict[str, Any]) ->None:
    if 'children' not in tok or not tok['children']:
        return
    
    # Get the first child which contains the text
    first_child = tok['children'][0]
    if first_child.get('type') != 'paragraph':
        return
        
    # Get the text content
    text = first_child.get('text', '')
    if not text:
        return
        
    # Check if it matches task list pattern
    match = TASK_LIST_ITEM.match(text)
    if not match:
        return
        
    # Extract checkbox status
    checkbox = match.group(1)
    checked = checkbox.lower() == '[x]'
    
    # Remove the checkbox part from text
    new_text = text[match.end():].lstrip()
    
    # Update the paragraph text
    first_child['text'] = new_text
    
    # Mark this as a task list item
    tok['type'] = 'task_list_item'
    tok['checked'] = checked
